relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: CGRP is known to be released during acute attacks of migraine that causes vasodilation in extracerebral arteries

relationships.subject: CGRP receptor inhibitors
relationships.evidence_quote: CGRP receptor inhibitors which bind to CGRP receptors in the cranial vasculature have been developed as drugs for migraine therapy

key_findings: Review of FDA-approved CGRP inhibitors including galcanezumab for migraine.
